title: Canonical bridge preserves direct-image composition
statement: For the section-normalized operations and compositors $o,c$ [def-sf-integral-system-operations] and canonical bridge $b$ [def-sf-integral-system-canonical-bridge], the bridge intertwines the supplied direct-image compositor with the intrinsic semilinear direct-image compositor [lem-sf-semilinear-proper-open-mate-pasting]: on each whole system $M$, $c_{f,g}(M);b_{fg}(M)=b_g(S_fM);R_g(b_f(M));s_{f,g}(M)$. This holds for every composable pair of scheme maps, with no properness or open-immersion restriction.

lean.statement:
theorem integralSystemBridgePushComposition (o : Operations l E) (c : Compositors l E o)
    (b : CanonicalBridge l E o) {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (M : System l E X) :
    (c.pushComp l E f g).hom.app M ≫ (b.push l E (f ≫ g)).hom.app M =
      (b.push l E g).hom.app ((Operations.push l E o f).obj M) ≫
        (ProEtale.SemilinearProperOpen.R (scalarRings l E) (scalarTransitions l E) g).map
          ((b.push l E f).hom.app M) ≫
        (ProEtale.SemilinearProperOpen.sComp
          (scalarRings l E) (scalarTransitions l E) f g).hom.app M
